# Copilot instructions for this repository

- Treat this project as a static website for Flor de Algodón Reborn.
- Prefer editing HTML, CSS, and JavaScript directly without adding build tooling.
- Preserve the existing Spanish copy style, navigation, and visual identity.
- Keep relative links and asset paths working after changes.
- Avoid breaking the review form, gallery modal, or WhatsApp CTA links.
- Favor small, safe edits and verify the affected page afterward.
- Act as a specialist in semantic HTML, SEO on-page, accessibility, and conversion by contact for an artisan niche website.
- Keep the site as an elegant showcase of handcrafted work, not a direct e-commerce storefront.
- Emphasize trust, emotional storytelling, and clear contact paths for inquiries or purchases.
